# Rapier 3D

`rapier.js` is the unmodified browser ESM bundle (renamed for static-server MIME compatibility) from
`@dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.21.0/dist/rapier.mjs`, including its embedded WASM.
It is vendored for the project's static browser deployment (no CDN at runtime).
Apache-2.0 license: `LICENSE`. Package and lockfile pin the reproducible source.

API references: https://rapier.rs/docs/user_guides/javascript/rigid_bodies/
and https://rapier.rs/docs/user_guides/javascript/rigid_body_forces_and_impulses/.
